scope: Numeric-only read-only audit of saved terminal30k per-frame metrics, fixed-pose49-times control and GN11 final NPS diagnostics
FP32_recomputation_owner: Root exporter; this receipt reads saved metric JSON and does not certify array recomputation

aggregation.PSNR: Per-frame clipRGB regionalMSE converted to -10log10(max(MSE,1e-12)), then equal mean of49 frames; not pooled MSE or last training PSNR
aggregation.other_metrics: Equal mean49 of the logged per-frame regional metric
aggregation.interaction: GN11-G10-N01+C00 on the explicitly named metric scale; algebraic single-seed contrast, not significance or mechanism proof
aggregation.numerically_adverse: Exact sign relative to0; not a visual/human acceptance verdict

fixed_pose_time_control.MAE_reference: Each arm own anchor-time static render at the same fixed pose/rays; RGB clipped, alpha raw; counterfactual timestamps with noGT accuracy score

GN11_final_NPS_diagnostics.scope: Intermediate render tensors, not Gaussian parameter gradients; feature ratio0 is invalid sentinel; no formula/weight changes or new experiment
